gloss_en: Kodesh (קֹדֶשׁ) — 'holiness / the holy' as an abstract substantive noun: the sacred quality or domain itself (not the verb 'to sanctify,' not kiddushin/betrothal as an act, and not a sanctified place-name); identified in Likutey Moharan as the aspect of chochmah/mochin, 'reishit' (firstness), divine influx (shefa), and the chuppah/makifin
